summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K report with the SEC, disclosing the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 9, 2026. The meeting set the number of directors at seven, elected all seven nominees, reappointed Zeifmans LLP as auditor, and authorized the board to fix auditor remuneration. The filing is a routine disclosure of a regular shareholder meeting and does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. It is a typical regulatory filing by a foreign private issuer.
